title: The tie is not duplication; it is the word 'lines'. The recall loop was picking the first candidate that ran, so half the old 4/8 were won by list order.
the_factor_this_round_attacked: rank 6 of r56: confusability / catalog poisoning. Real, unbuilt, and closable from inside this repository.

what_r52_had_concluded_and_why_it_was_in.r52: four near-duplicate skills break selection at |S|=4
what_r52_had_concluded_and_why_it_was_in.measured_this_round: the four skills were only TWO operations -- `sort` and `sort -u`, each filed twice
what_r52_had_concluded_and_why_it_was_in.so: duplication inflated the tie but did not cause it

the_real_cause.store: 5 skills: tac, rev, cat, wc -l, sort -u
the_real_cause.why: the ask shares the word 'lines' with BOTH line-operations. It contains nothing that separates them -- the discriminating word is 'unique', and a paraphrase drops it.
the_real_cause.what_the_old_loop_did: ran the candidates in list order and returned the first one that executed and verified
the_real_cause.consequence: correct when the target happened to come first, wrong when it did not (r52's `sort` without `-u`). The 4/8 in r50 contained answers won by ordering, not by evidence.
the_real_cause.the_hardest_admission: with only TWO taught operations -- `count the lines of` and `unique lines of` -- the ask is already a genuine tie. A user who taught two things can already not be served by ranking.

the_fix.where: in the recall loop itself, not in the door
the_fix.rule: _refuse_if_operations_tie: if more than one DISTINCT OPERATION ties for best word overlap, return no candidates at all
the_fix.deduplication_not_suppression: one operation filed under several skeletons still counts as one -- the signature is the program plus its first two arguments
the_fix.what_it_deliberately_does_not_do: it does NOT refuse at zero word overlap. Refusing there also disabled the verb-selection fallback (r50), and a 10-skill catalog went from answering correctly to returning None. Measured, reverted, narrowed.
the_fix.raised_to_the_user_by: answer_or_ask -> select_or_ask, which names the operations rather than picking one

the_measurement_after.note: the old 4/8 and the new 4/8 are the same count with different content: the new four are the ones supported by evidence that the sentence actually contains

external_context_2026.pattern: tool-catalog consolidation is being done by hand across the ecosystem -- exodus-mcp 100 -> 72 canonical concepts with 39 deprecated aliases and parity tests; agent-herder 99 -> 40; paperclip rejecting conflicting same-name descriptors with 409 rather than selecting an ambiguous binding; cyanheads deduplicating identical records while keeping case variants distinct
external_context_2026.what_this_repo_adds: the same rule enforced at selection time rather than at catalog-review time, and the measured proof that the tie exists at |S|=5, long before catalog size is a problem
external_context_2026.the rule they all converge on: identical duplicates collapse; CONFLICTING ones fail loudly rather than selecting an ambiguous binding

what_the_first_principles_reading_says: the limiting factor was never 'the loop picks badly'. It was 'the loop is entitled to pick'. Removing that entitlement cost nothing except an answer that was only sometimes right, and it is the same correction r55 made one layer up: a system that cannot distinguish its answers from its guesses must not present them identically.
what_is_real: a unique operation is still answered
a tie is refused and raised as a named question
one operation filed twice is still selectable
what_is_not_real: that teaching more operations helps -- it creates ties
that any of this is a language model
